objective: Explain Mythical Void's genetics, Phaser world, and bounded AI media to adult players, partners, and press.
audience: Adult players, parents and guardians, creators, partners, and games press; not child-targeted advertising
channel: Unassigned social, press, or partner channel
copy:
Mythical Void is built in layers. A structured genetics system shapes a companion’s appearance, personality, rarity, and cosmic affinity. Phaser 3 runs the world in your browser, from exploration and guardians to the village and story scenes. Then an optional, age-gated AI layer can turn that in-game identity into a portrait or short cinematic companion moment.

The important boundary matters: AI adds expression, while the story, dialogue, safety decisions, and player choices remain authored and understandable.
measurement: No publication authorized; choose a channel and approved measure before scheduling.
